subject: Marketplace co-host ops — 5pm UTC squeeze and fallback plan
body:
From: Elena Díaz <elena.diaz@siemco.com>
To: rachel_kim@redwood.com
Cc: MarketplaceOps <marketplace-ops@gcp.partner>
Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 21:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood + Siemco marketplace demo — Friday 17:00 UTC concern

Hi Rachel,

Thanks for the quick turnaround on the invite. We actually have an exec touchpoint that runs into the 5pm UTC window — I wanted to flag that our preferred earliest slot is 16:00 UTC and latest is 18:30 UTC, but anything right at 17:00 UTC will squeeze our theatre team.

Two asks from our side:
- Can we keep the runbook light for the first 30 minutes and focus on the host handoff + billing workflow?
- If the 17:00 UTC slot is unavoidable for Redwood operations, can a shadow host from Siemco stay in a -15/+15 minute buffer to pick up any Qs after the handoff?

I'll leave coordination to your team — Elena

---
From: rachel_kim@redwood.com
To: Elena Díaz <elena.diaz@siemco.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com, MarketplaceOps <marketplace-ops@gcp.partner>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 08:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood + Siemco marketplace demo — Friday 17:00 UTC concern

Elena — thanks for the heads up. Short answer: we can avoid the 17:00 UTC hard cut. Proposed options below — please pick which works for your execs: 

1) Move earlier: 16:00 UTC — 45m core demo, 15m Q&A (we retain same host/responsibilities).
2) Keep 17:00 UTC but split: 17:00–17:30 Redwood lead + 17:30–18:00 Siemco deep-dive (Siemco shadow host stays).
3) Move later: 18:00 UTC start with our canary run blocked for first 10 minutes (we can compress housekeeping).

I attached a slimmed runbook (redwood-cohost-runbook-v2.pdf) and the latest agenda (siemco-demo-agenda.xlsx). Also linking the HubSpot deal for reference.

Can Vanessa and Karthik confirm internal ops (hosts/fallback) so I can reply to Elena with a single option?

Best,
Rachel
Product Partnerships — Redwood Inference

[Attachment: redwood-cohost-runbook-v2.pdf (PDF)]
[Attachment: siemco-demo-agenda.xlsx (Excel)]

---
From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
To: rachel_kim@redwood.com
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 09:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood + Siemco marketplace demo — Friday 17:00 UTC concern

Rachel — 16:00 UTC is our safest bet from an ops perspective. Notes:
- I can host 16:00–16:35 (core product), Karthik can take the 16:35–17:00 section for the SI technical handover.
- Kimberly: can you confirm if we have an AWS SE available for 16:00–16:45? If not, we can proceed without the SE and have the recording shared immediately after.
- If Siemco insists on the dual-window, we can still do 17:00–17:30 but only if Elena confirms shadow host coverage for post-demo Qs.

Vanessa
Senior Partner Ops — Redwood Inference

---
From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: rachel_kim@redwood.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 10:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood + Siemco marketplace demo — Friday 17:00 UTC concern

I can ask AWS SE to hold 16:00–16:45 tentatively — they said tentative hold is fine but they need a day-of reminder. Prefer earlier 16:00 as well (less risk of overlapping exec blocks in US).

If we go 16:00, I'll set a 15:30 internal dry run for the ops hosts.

Kimberly
Partner Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference

---
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: rachel_kim@redwood.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: MarketplaceOps <marketplace-ops@gcp.partner>, Elena Díaz <elena.diaz@siemco.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 11:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood + Siemco marketplace demo — Friday 17:00 UTC concern

Agree 16:00 UTC flow. A few operational items to lock: 
- Fallback agent: set to 'vanessa_ortiz+oncall' in the runbook so we can claim ownership if the host drops.
- Recording + transcript: enable auto-share to the HubSpot deal post-call. I'll add the HubSpot hook in the runbook link (see Drive).
- Can we limit model load for the first 20 minutes (sampling only) so the canary doesn't saturate our Dedicated pool? If yes, ops can flip to full load at 16:20 in the runbook.

I'll update the runbook Drive doc after this thread and ping the partners channel.

-Karthik
Infra & Dedication — Redwood Inference

---
From: rachel_kim@redwood.com
To: Elena Díaz <elena.diaz@siemco.com>, MarketplaceOps <marketplace-ops@gcp.partner>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com, AWS SalesEng <se-aws@amazon.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 14:02:00 -0800
Subject: Final: Redwood + Siemco marketplace demo — scheduled 16:00 UTC (15:30 internal dry run)

Elena — thanks for the note and flexibility. We will schedule the external demo for Friday at 16:00 UTC per Vanessa/Kimberly/Karthik ops confirmations. Details: 

- External demo: Friday, 16:00–17:00 UTC (core run 16:00–16:45, Siemco deep-dive 16:45–17:00).
- Internal dry run: Friday, 15:30–15:55 UTC — mandatory for Redwood hosts (Vanessa/Karthik/Kimberly), optional for Siemco shadow (recommended).
- Fallback: vanessa_ortiz+oncall will be primary fallback; karthik_iyer will take infra rollback if needed.
- Load plan: demo starts with sampling-only calls for first 20 minutes; ops will flip to full demo at 16:20 if latency and KV cache are stable.
- Recording and transcript: auto-post to HubSpot deal after the call.

Sharing the two attachments and the Drive runbook link again. Please reply here with one-line confirmation if the timing is good on your side so we can send the calendar invite to execs.

Thanks all — Rachel
Product Partnerships — Redwood Inference
